Scanlines.Name: Scanlines
Scanlines.Hint: Horizontal lines and RGB pattern over windows and chat messages.

Glow.Name: Glow
Glow.Hint: Light bloom around highlighted elements and critical roll results.

Aberration.Name: Chromatic Aberration
Aberration.Hint: Shaking color fringes on rollable text when hovering over it.

AccentColor.Name: Accent Color
AccentColor.Hint: Color for the values and rollable labels in the system sheets. The player color uses your user color, lightened if it's too dark.
